tagline: Coastal Luxury & Oceanfront Prestige on Marine Drive

timings.early_check_in_policy: Early check-in from 8:00 AM available on request for INR 2,000.
timings.late_check_out_policy: Late check-out up to 4:00 PM available for INR 2,000.

rooms.name: Bay View Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Floor-to-ceiling glass windows framing panoramic Arabian Sea vistas, acoustic glazing, marble bathroom with deep tub, and Illy espresso bar.

rooms.name: Marine Executive Suite
rooms.description: Spacious corner suite offering dual views of the Arabian Sea sunset and city lights, with a dedicated boardroom-style work lounge.

rooms.name: Queen's Necklace Penthouse
rooms.description: The crowning jewel of South Mumbai, featuring private rooftop terrace, dining room for 8, grand piano, and 24/7 dedicated butler.
amenities: Complimentary Breakfast for up to 4 Guests

dining.name: Zaffran & Tide Fine Dining
dining.cuisine: Modern Coastal Indian & Royal Mughlai Cuisine
dining.breakfast_timings: 6:30 AM – 10:30 AM at The Bayview Brasserie
dining.breakfast_inclusion: Complimentary full buffet breakfast for Marine Executive Suite & Penthouse guests. INR 950 + taxes for Deluxe Room guests.
dining.highlights: Bespoke tasting menus paired with sommelier-curated global wines.

dining.name: The Sea Lounge & Patisserie
dining.cuisine: English Afternoon High Tea, Single-Estate Coffees & French Pastries
dining.highlights: Grand piano performances accompanied by ocean sunsets.

menu.name: Artisan Bombay Cutting Chai
menu.description: Assam strong CTC tea leaves slow-simmered with freshly crushed lemongrass, ginger, and green cardamom.

menu.name: Alphonso Mango Lassi
menu.description: Rich artisanal whipped yogurt blended with Ratnagiri Alphonso mango pulp and saffron strands.

menu.name: Steamed Chicken / Veg Dim Sum Basket
menu.description: Six delicate translucent dumplings filled with water chestnuts, scallions, and shiitake mushrooms, served with ginger soy dip.

menu.name: Golden Turmeric & Lentil Comfort Soup
menu.description: Mild, soothing organic red lentil soup infused with fresh yellow turmeric, cumin, and cilantro.

menu.name: Classic Mumbai Pav Bhaji Fondue
menu.description: Rich spiced vegetable mash enriched with Amul butter, served fondue-style with warm buttered brioche pao.

menu.name: Mumbai Kanda Poha & Masala Omelette
menu.description: Flattened rice tempered with mustard, roasted peanuts, and curry leaves, accompanied by a fluffy masala omelette.

menu.name: Rose Petal Kulfi with Falooda Sev
menu.description: Traditional dense slow-churned rose kulfi topped with basil seeds, chilled falooda sev, and rabdi.

amenities.name: Infinity Sea View Pool
amenities.details: Heated 8th-floor outdoor infinity pool looking directly out over the Arabian Sea waves.

amenities.name: Sea Mist Spa & Salon
amenities.details: Full-service luxury spa with aromatherapy, sauna, and ocean-facing couple treatment suites.

amenities.name: 24/7 Panoramic Fitness Centre
amenities.details: High-tech gym equipped with LifeFitness machines facing the Queen's Necklace.

services.name: Extra Pillows
services.description: Choice of down feather, memory foam, or buckwheat pillows.

services.name: Extra Towels
services.description: Luxury oversized bath towels and washcloths.

services.name: Complimentary Water Bottles
services.description: Sealed sparkling or still premium spring water bottles.

services.name: Private Airport Chauffeur (CSMT / BOM)
services.description: Private luxury sedan transfer to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport via coastal road.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours prior to arrival.
policies.pets: Pets not permitted due to high-rise building regulations.
policies.smoking: 100% non-smoking property. Penalty INR 5,000 applies for room smoking.
policies.id_requirements: Valid government photo ID required at check-in.

faqs.question: What time is check-in?
faqs.answer: Check-in at Oleria Mumbai is from 3:00 PM onwards, and check-out is at 12:00 PM noon.

faqs.question: Where is the hotel located?
faqs.answer: Oleria Mumbai is located at 108 Marine Drive, Nariman Point, directly overlooking the Arabian Sea and the Queen's Necklace promenade.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes, our 8th-floor heated outdoor infinity pool offers direct sea views and is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
